name: data-gov
description: data.gov.uk (National Data Library): the UK government's open data directory. The CLI searches and reads dataset metadata through the public CKAN JSON API, lists data files and previews from dataset pages, and browses the curated theme collections and their chart data.

commands.name: search-datasets
commands.summary: Search the UK open data directory (CKAN package_search). Returns dataset metadata including publisher, licence and resources. Filter with Solr fq, sort, and page by offset.

params.name: fq
params.description: Solr filter query. Examples: organization:bristol-city-council (publisher slug), res_format:CSV (file format), license_id:uk-ogl (Open Government Licence only). Combine filters with AND.

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. 'score desc, metadata_modified desc' means most relevant; 'metadata_modified desc' means most recent.

commands.name: get-dataset
commands.summary: Get full metadata for one dataset by its UUID or CKAN name (CKAN package_show). Includes publisher, licence, description and every resource with its URL, format and date.

params.name: id
params.description: Dataset UUID (the first path segment after /dataset/ on data.gov.uk) or CKAN dataset name

commands.name: list-dataset-files
commands.summary: List the data links shown on a dataset page on data.gov.uk: name, format, date, and the link or preview URL for each file.

commands.name: preview-datafile
commands.summary: Open the preview page for one data file of a dataset. Shows the file title and a preview, or a message saying no preview is available.

params.name: file_id
params.description: Data file (CKAN resource) UUID, taken from a preview link or from resources[].id

commands.name: list-filter-options
commands.summary: List the filter values the directory search offers (publisher names, topics and formats). Use these to build search filters.

commands.name: list-collections
commands.summary: List the curated theme collections on the data.gov.uk home page (Business and economy, Environment, etc.).

commands.name: list-collection-topics
commands.summary: List the topics inside a theme collection, e.g. environment has weather and air-quality.

params.name: theme
params.description: Collection theme slug: business-and-economy, environment, government-and-parliament, land-and-property, people, transport, early-years

commands.name: get-collection-topic
commands.summary: Get a collection topic page: headline chart title, description, the chart-data download link and the external 'get the data' link.

commands.name: download-collection-chart-data
commands.summary: Download the raw data behind a collection topic's headline chart, e.g. the UK annual mean temperature series.

notes: data.gov.uk's /api/3/action/* redirects (301) to https://ckan.publishing.service.gov.uk/api/3/action/*, so the commands call that host directly. The responses are standard CKAN JSON.
The dataset UUID in data.gov.uk URLs (/dataset/{uuid}/{slug}) is the CKAN package id, and the slug is the CKAN 'name'. Either works with get-dataset.
search-datasets filtering uses Solr fq syntax: organization:<publisher-slug>, res_format:CSV, license_id:uk-ogl. Publisher slugs are in organization.name of search results.

The HTML directory search (/search?query=&publisher=&topic=&format=&sort=recent&open_government_licence_only=on&page=N) also works, but its result markup was not captured. The CKAN API is the reliable route.
Collection topic pages embed chart data in script#chart-<hash>-json, and the hash differs per page. Use download-collection-chart-data to get the series instead.
Everything is public. No login is needed.
